en.headline: 72-year-old hiker dies after collapse on Ap Lei Chau’s Yuk Kwai Shan
en.dek: The man, surnamed Kwok, was found unconscious with head and leg injuries while hiking alone on Sunday morning and was airlifted to hospital, where he was certified dead.
body: A 72-year-old man died after collapsing while hiking alone on Yuk Kwai Shan in Ap Lei Chau on Sunday morning.

Police received a report at about 9.13am that a hiker had been found unconscious with head and leg abrasions on the hill. Fire and rescue personnel went up from Lei Tung Estate bus terminus. The Government Flying Service helicopter lifted him to Pamela Youde Nethersole Eastern Hospital, where he was certified dead at 10.29am. The cause of death awaits autopsy.

The man, surnamed Kwok, had a history of hypertension, diabetes and heart disease. Closed-circuit television showed he left South Horizons at 6.23am. Police said the case appeared non-suspicious and referred it to the Aberdeen Divisional Miscellaneous Investigation Team.

zh.headline: 鴨脷洲玉桂山72歲行山漢送院後不治
zh.dek: 姓郭老翁今早獨自行山期間暈倒，頭腳擦傷，直升機吊起送東區醫院後證實死亡，死因有待驗屍確定。
body: 一名72歲男子今日上午在鴨脷洲玉桂山獨自行山期間暈倒，其後送院不治。
警方早上約9時13分接獲途人報案，指一名老翁在小玉桂山行山時懷疑暈倒，頭及腳擦傷。消防及救援人員由利東邨巴士總站上山，政府飛行服務隊直升機將他吊起送往東區醫院，上午10時29分證實死亡，死因有待驗屍後確定。
事主姓郭，有血壓高、糖尿病及心臟病。閉路電視顯示他今早6時23分離開海怡半島。警方初步調查相信事件無可疑，交由香港仔警區雜項調查隊跟進。
